messages:
Priya (Support): FYI — AcmeCorp (paid tier) opened a ticket: sudden p99 latency jump after yesterday's billing push. They see spiky 429s and client retries. Reported p95 ~300ms, p99 ~2.1s. Trace IDs: abc123... they pasted a few.
Jamal (SRE): Can you paste a repro curl or sample request headers? We need request_id / token the customer used so we can trace through the proxy and token-bucket metrics.
Priya (Support): Repro from customer:
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer tok-acme-01' -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
They said the 429s happen after a burst of ~60 requests in <30s.
Elena (Billing): We rolled out the new per-customer burst cap yesterday at 2026-03-10 18:20 UTC. Default burst reduced from 300 -> 50 for non-enterprise tokens as part of the billing-rate-limit patch. AcmeCorp should still be on a paid plan but their token was flagged as "standard" due to a mismatch in org mapping — looks like a sync bug.
Jamal (SRE): OK that sync bug could explain sudden 429s. From observability: I looked at proxy logs for token tok-acme-01 and see token-bucket rejections at 18:22:05, 18:22:12, 18:22:18, then client retries at +600ms and +1.2s which pushes tail. Short spikes like this blow up p99 but barely move p95.
Priya (Support): The customer is asking why our dashboard shows p95 stable while their dashboard (internal) shows big p99 spikes. They're upset the SLA doesn't reflect this.
Jamal (SRE): This is a common mismatch — our overview panels use 1m rollup windows and compute quantiles on rollups; short ~10-20s bursts get smoothed. The customer's instrumented SDK reports raw histograms at 1s resolution. Two different sources. I ran a quick query:
```
# prometheus-ish pseudo-query
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket[30s])) by (le))
```
vs our dashboard panel which uses `query: p99_over_1m_rollup(service, 1m)` — result: raw 0.99=1.9s, rollup p99=0.45s.
Elena (Billing): We should absolutely fix the org mapping so AcmeCorp gets enterprise burst, but meanwhile can we do a temporary quota bump? I can flip their token to enterprise-tier burst 500 for 24h.
Jamal (SRE): Please do the temp bump. Also action items on observability: update the SLO dashboard to include a raw-histogram panel (30s window) for high-sensitivity customers and annotate the rollout time. That will reduce confusion. Also add per-token rejection rate metric to the SLO dashboard so 429s are visible.
Priya (Support): I'll propose the temporary bump and the client-side mitigations: add exponential backoff + jitter and avoid tight retry loops. Customer asked for repro steps — shared the curl and the trace ids. They're happy with a temporary bump if we can confirm it's safe.
Jamal (SRE): Mitigations we should implement quickly:
- Immediate: Elena enables 24h burst bump for tok-acme-01.
- Short term (hours): add dashboard panel with `rate(token_bucket_rejects[1m])` and a raw-histogram p99 (30s window) for affected services.
- Medium term (days): fix org mapping sync, add automated test to ensure paid tokens map correctly after billing rollouts, and add runbook for burst config changes.
- Long term: consider circuit-breaker that throttles retries per-client and surface per-client retry counts in logs.
Priya (Support): Customer notified and accepted temporary bump. They're running tests now.
support-bot: [alert] Incident annotation: billing-rate-limit-rollout applied 2026-03-10T18:20:00Z flagged tokens: 112; linked ticket #7891.
Jamal (SRE): One more note about p95 vs p99: p95 is often insensitive to short, high-amplitude spikes. For SLA conversations we need to define whether SLA is p95 or p99 and at which aggregation resolution. Recommend we document that in the SLO page and avoid relying solely on 1m rollups for p99 conversation.
Elena (Billing): Done — temporary bump applied. I'll follow up with a PR to fix the mapping and add an automated check. ETA: EOD.
Priya (Support): I'll close the customer loop after we confirm their test results. Action items captured: temp bump (Elena), runbook + dashboard changes (Jamal), mapping fix (Elena), postmortem + communication (Priya). Thanks. :white_check_mark:
Jamal (SRE): I'll open a short postmortem template and ping eng-sre and eng-platform. Also adding a dashboard note explaining rollup vs raw-histogram differences.
